liquidity_funding.text: Liquidity rose by {{liquidity.change@FY2025}} to {{liquidity@FY2025}}, of which {{undrawn_facilities@FY2025}} in undrawn committed facilities, broadly unchanged on the prior year, and cash and cash-like investments increased by {{cash_like.change@FY2025}} to {{cash_like@FY2025}}.

Near-term maturities are well covered: debt due within one year fell by {{debt_due_1y.change@FY2025}} to {{debt_due_1y@FY2025}}, taking short-term debt cover up by {{short_term_debt_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{short_term_debt_cover@FY2025}}, and borrowings due within two years declined by {{borrowings_due_2y.change@FY2025}} to {{borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}}, so liquidity covers them {{liquidity_to_borrowings_due_2y@FY2025}} times.

Cash flow after lease payments is the weaker measure: FCF after leases fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, taking FCF after leases to debt down by {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}}, as cash from operations declined by {{cfo.change@FY2025}} to {{cfo@FY2025}}.

Customer prepayments remain a material part of the funding base: contract liabilities rose by {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2025}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2025}}, while advance ticket cover fell by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2025}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Cash generation: FCF after leases fell by {{fcf_after_leases.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_after_leases@FY2025}}, only {{fcf_after_leases_to_debt@FY2025}} of debt, so the cash left for debt holders after lease payments is thin.

Earnings: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2025}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}, and FFO to debt fell by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}} against a peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Leverage: gross leverage rose by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2025}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, and interest coverage of {{interest_coverage@FY2025}} remains below the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2025}}.

Cost base: industrial action in the first half weighed on the result, and costs related to environmental regulation and navigation and landing charges added to it, with operating profit down {{operating_profit.change@FY2025}} to {{operating_profit@FY2025}}.
